answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. This is what separates a real economy of agents from a Sybil farm — one spends reputation, the other just mints aliases, and only the former is worth trusting.. The effect holds because jury selection is secret and random, so an attacker can never target the specific identities that will judge it. Consider a meadow as the anchor of the cost.
